display.purpose: Today's click count, the single large figure in a clicks panel.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the sign-in card title.

subhead.purpose: Section headings above a group of panels, such as Clicks on a link page.

body.purpose: Default text. Stylistic set 1 ('ss01') is on for all Golos Text.

body-sm.purpose: Table cells, inputs, sentences inside panels, menu items, toasts.

control.purpose: Button labels. Small buttons use 0.8125rem, large 0.9375rem.

nav.purpose: Top bar nav items, Ink 2 at rest and Ink when current.

label.purpose: Field labels, segments, tag toggles; hints and meta lines at weight 400.

column-label.purpose: Table column headers. Sentence case, Ink 3, so the figures lead.

caption.purpose: Map key, tooltip secondary lines, the View as table toggle; badges at 600, tag chips at 560.

code.purpose: Short codes, the url.mekhroj.com/ host prefix, click timestamps. Host in Ink 3, code in Ink.

code-specimen.purpose: A link's short code set large on its own page; host prefix at 1rem in Ink 3.

wordmark.purpose: The product name beside its mark, in the top bar and above the sign-in card.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: dialogs, the account menu, the chart tooltip, toasts, the sticky bulk-action bar.

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: The same floating layers in the dark theme.

shadows.name: segment
shadows.purpose: The selected segment inside its Sunken trough.

shadows.name: segment-dark
shadows.purpose: The selected segment in the dark theme.

shadows.name: current-page-rule
shadows.purpose: A 2px Ink underline at the bottom edge of the top bar under the current nav item.

shadows.name: station-halo
shadows.purpose: A Surface halo around a station disc so it cuts the line behind it.

shadows.name: station-expiring
shadows.purpose: The extra Warn ring on a station whose link expires within a week.

shadows.name: key-expiring
shadows.purpose: The Warn tint halo on the expiring marker in the line map key.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve, used for every state change.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, border and background changes on hover and press; tooltip fade and 4px rise; the More options chevron turning.

motion.name: t-base
motion.purpose: Station scale on highlight, stale-data dimming to 60%, dialog and toast entrance.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: A new link's station scales in from 0.3 with a fade; the create form's confirmation strip fades in from 4px above. The one authored moment.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Skeleton rows on first load only.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The 14px loading ring inside a busy button.

breakpoints.name: dashboard-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard top row stacks with the Clicks panel first; the bottom row becomes two columns with Top links across both.

breakpoints.name: table-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Links table hides its lowest-priority columns.

breakpoints.name: detail-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Link page panel grid becomes one column.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: Nav moves behind a menu button, Shorten shows its icon only, the create form stacks, page padding drops to 20px 16px 40px.

breakpoints.name: dashboard-single
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard panels become one column; page gap 16px, create panel padding 16px.

breakpoints.name: table-medium
breakpoints.purpose: Links table hides further columns and its panel padding drops to 12px.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Line map labels stack above tracks; code rows stack; list rows on manage pages drop their stats.

containers.name: manage-page
containers.purpose: Collections, tags, invites and settings pages.

containers.name: auth-card
containers.purpose: Sign-in and invite sign-up card, with the wordmark above it.

containers.name: account-menu
containers.purpose: Account menu popover, anchored to the right edge of the page container.

themes.switch: System / Light / Dark segmented control in the account menu and in Settings > Appearance.
themes.applied: data-theme on the root element, set before the first paint from the stored choice or the system setting; System follows the device live and other tabs follow a change.
themes.storage: The choice is saved in this browser; System clears it.
themes.note: Dark is a separate set of steps tuned on its own ground, not an inversion of light.

narrative.overview:
Spur is a working tool for a small circle of people who make and share short links, and its surfaces stay quiet so the links and their numbers lead. A cool stone neutral family runs through two composed themes: a pale cool ground under white panels in light, a near-black ground under one-step-lighter panels in dark. Panels are flat and ruled off by hairlines, the one primary action is near-black on light and near-white on dark, and the type never raises its voice. Against that quiet, one device speaks: the line map, where each collection is a thin line in its own colour and its links sit on it as stations sized by clicks. The line colours are the only saturated colour in the interface, and they always mean a collection or a tag.

The interface is an operating tool, not a showcase. Density is moderate and even: 36px controls, 12px table cell padding, 20px gaps between panels, a 1360px page. Standard web controls are used throughout; the system contributes the two themes, the two typefaces, the density, one signature component and one copper accent that marks exactly three things. Motion is short and confined to state changes, and page content does not animate in on load.

Spur began as a Tashkent Metro station, with a granite bar, marble floor, bronze lettering and a band of ceramic tile, and was quietened at the owner's request: the materials became role tokens, the ornament went, and the metro survives only as the line map and the branch in the wordmark. It refuses the category default of a grey sidebar, a blue accent, rows of stat tiles and a lone line chart, and it refuses ornament.
keyCharacteristics: A quiet top bar on the surface colour, ruled off by a hairline, over a pale cool ground in light and a near-black ground in dark.
Two composed themes chosen as System, Light or Dark; dark is its own set of steps, not an inversion.
Flat panels with 1px hairlines and no resting shadow, the create panel included.
Seven line colours reserved for collection and tag identity, assigned in a fixed order and tuned per theme.
One copper accent for today's bar, the spike rule and the wordmark's dot, and nothing else.
Golos Text for the interface; Red Hat Mono for short codes, the short-link host and click times.
The line map: collections drawn as 2px coloured lines with links as stations sized by clicks.
150 to 200ms ease-out on state changes; one 240ms arrival when a new link is created.

rules.name: The Line Colour Rule
rules.body: Line colours mean a collection or a tag and nothing else. Buttons, links, focus rings, selection, charts, status and decoration never use them.

rules.name: The Fixed Order Rule
rules.body: Line colours are offered and assigned in the order red, blue, green, violet, amber, teal, with slate for no collection. The order is part of the identity; do not reshuffle it per screen or per theme.

rules.name: The Copper Marks Rule
rules.body: Copper marks three things: today's bar, the spike onset rule and the wordmark's dot. The spike label is the only copper text, and it uses Copper Ink. Nothing else in the interface is copper.

rules.name: The Composed Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark is its own set of steps tuned on its own ground, not an inversion of light. Components name a role token, never a hex, so both themes follow; the only literals are the white label on a danger button and the white check on a colour swatch, which stay white in both themes.

rules.name: The Quiet Health Rule
rules.body: A healthy link shows no badge. Status colour appears only when a link is paused, expired, expiring within a week or in error.

rules.name: The Code Face Rule
rules.body: Anything a person would type after the slash, and the host before it, is set in Red Hat Mono. Everything else is Golos Text.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case and muted: column headers are Ink 3 at 500, so the figures under them lead. Nothing in the interface is uppercase or letter-spaced; the only tracking is negative, on the wordmark and the display figure.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Every panel rests flat on the ground with a hairline, the create panel and the sign-in card included. Only floating layers cast the overlay shadow.

dos: Do reference role tokens (Surface, Ink 2, Hairline) in every component so light and dark both follow, and give any new token its own dark step.
Do use Primary Fill for the one main action on a surface, and Ink for the focus ring, the current-page underline and active chart marks.
Do show a collection as a line mark and a tag as a line dot (10px, 7px in chips), always next to its name in text.
Do draw line colours on Surface; light Line Amber clears 3:1 there only just (3.12:1).
Do set short codes, the host prefix and click times in Red Hat Mono, with the host in Ink 3 and the code in Ink.
Do separate panels from the ground with a 1px Hairline, and rows inside panels with 1px Sunken.
Do keep state transitions at 150 to 200ms on `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, and respect reduced motion.
Do pair every status colour with an icon and a word.
Do dim stale data to 60% while it refetches rather than flashing a skeleton.
Do keep creating a link one step away: the Shorten button in the top bar on every signed-in page, and the `n` key anywhere.
donts: Don't use a line colour for a button, link, focus ring, chart bar, status or decoration.
Don't add ornament: no tile bands, patterns, textures or decorative colour strips; the line map is the one signature device.
Don't use Copper for anything but today's bar, the spike rule and label, and the wordmark's dot.
Don't derive the dark theme by inverting or filtering light values; each role has its own dark step.
Don't put a shadow on a resting panel, the create panel included; Overlay is for floating layers only.
Don't set labels in uppercase or letter-spaced type.
Don't add entrance animation to page content on load; panels and rows appear without motion.
Don't show a badge on a healthy link.
